how.title: How Zupport works
how.s1.b: Find creators and organizations doing work you care about.
how.s2.b: Pick a monthly membership or send a one-time tip.

why.title: Built for trust
why.1.b: Monthly memberships give creators income they can plan around.
why.2.b: Support with Telebirr. No foreign card needed.
why.3.b: Verification means a defined identity check was completed. It is not an endorsement.
why.4.b: Platform fees are shown to creators up front.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.1.a: A platform where people support creators, ministries, educators and nonprofits through monthly memberships and one-time tips.
faq.2.a: During early access you pay by Telebirr, then submit your transaction ID and a screenshot. We confirm each payment by hand and unlock your access once approved.
faq.3.a: Zupport takes a platform fee on payments. The final fee terms will be published before launch.
faq.4.a: Creators post videos on YouTube as unlisted and embed them on their Zupport page.
